title: Configuration Loading via Dynamic Uncompiled Scripting Evaluators
pattern: Executing active, uncompiled scripting languages (like Lisp or JavaScript) inside configuration files to compute static environment parameters.
why_bad: Introduces severe Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. It bypasses type-checks, breaks static analysis, and introduces untestable, non-deterministic logic paths into system startup.
detection: Evaluating external scripting syntax or dynamic code runtimes inside configuration bootstrap structures.
fix: Replace executable configuration scripts with flat, declarative, schema-checked data formats (like TOML, YAML, or JSON) that carry no execution capabilities.
source: Harold Abelson et al. - *Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs* (1996, MIT Press).pdf, Chapter 4; Heather Adkins et al., - *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 14.
